nvitk.stats.violin_hemodynamics
===============================

.. py:module:: nvitk.stats.violin_hemodynamics

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Cohort violin + strip hemodynamics plots from qvtpy ``image_measurements``.

   Shared by the CLI script ``scripts/pesa_brain/plotter/violin_hemodynamics.py``
   and the QC GUI cohort-violin dock.

   :type:  list[tuple[str, str, str]]
   :value: [('L_ICA', 'L_ICA', 'TCBF & ICAs'), ('R_ICA', 'R_ICA', 'TCBF & ICAs'), ('Basilar', 'Basilar',...


.. py:data:: TERRITORY_COLORS
   :type:  dict[str, str]

.. py:data:: METRICS
   :type:  list[dict[str, Any]]

.. py:function:: resolve_pipeline_id(pipeline_version: str) -> str

   Resolve a pipeline-version token (or a known qvtpy alias) to the canonical qvtpy pipeline id.


.. py:function:: load_long_measurements(*, pipeline_id: str, variable_ids: list[str], subjects: str | None = None) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Load long-format image_measurements for the given variables.


.. py:function:: derive_tcbf_rows(flow_df: pandas.DataFrame) -> pandas.DataFrame

   TCBF = LICA + RICA + BASILAR flow_mean per subject.


.. py:function:: prepare_plot_frame(long_df: pandas.DataFrame, *, variable_id: str, specs: list[tuple[str, str, str]], derive_tcbf: bool) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Filter/reshape long measurements into the violin-plot frame: ``subject_uid``/``vessel``/``group``/``value``.

   Optionally derives a synthetic TCBF row per subject, maps region ids to
   display vessel names and violin groups per *specs*, and drops zero
   placeholder values (a project convention for "not measured").


.. py:function:: flag_outliers_iqr(df: pandas.DataFrame, *, k: float = 1.5) -> pandas.Series

   Return boolean mask of IQR outliers, computed per vessel.


.. py:function:: flag_low_values(df: pandas.DataFrame, *, thresh: float) -> pandas.Series

   Return boolean mask of values strictly below ``thresh``.


.. py:function:: low_vals_export_df(df: pandas.DataFrame, *, thresh: float) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Build subject/vessel/value table for values below ``thresh``.


.. py:function:: draw_violin_figure(plot_df: pandas.DataFrame, *, title: str, ylabel: str, panel: str, outlier_rem: bool = False, outlier_high: bool = False, flag_low_vals: bool = False, low_val_thresh: float = 50.0, highlight_subject: str | None = None, fig: matplotlib.figure.Figure | None = None, figsize: tuple[float, float] | None = None) -> matplotlib.figure.Figure | None

   Draw a territory-grouped violin plot onto *fig* (or a new figure).

   When ``outlier_rem`` is True and ``highlight_subject`` is set, that subject's
   points are retained even if they are IQR outliers, and highlighted on the plot.


.. py:function:: plot_violin_figure(plot_df: pandas.DataFrame, *, title: str, ylabel: str, panel: str, output_path: pathlib.Path, outlier_rem: bool = False, outlier_high: bool = False, flag_low_vals: bool = False, low_val_thresh: float = 50.0, highlight_subject: str | None = None) -> pathlib.Path | None

   Draw and save a violin figure to *output_path*.


.. py:function:: metric_by_key(key: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None

   Look up a metric's spec dict in ``METRICS`` by its key; ``None`` if not found.
